{{Quote|Ordinarily, Aargonar is an unimportant planet in and of itself.|Anonymous|<ref name="R59:EL" />}}
'''Aargonar''' was a dusty, desert-climate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Aargonar was an insignificant desert world with few population.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The terrain was reminiscent of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, with rock arches and stone spires dotting the once watery-planet.<ref name="R59:EL" /> The planet had several [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Aargonar 3]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The planet was known to house numerous [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlaccs]] which were respected and even revered by the local sentient population.<ref name="TCSWE" /> It was also home to [[Hrumph/Legends|Hrumphs]] and [[Gouka dragon]]s.<ref name="R59:EL" />

==History==
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Aargonar was located within space controlled by [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Aargonar_3.jpg|thumb|left|Anakin Skywalker and A'Sharad Hett fought on Aargonar during the Clone Wars|200px]]

The world was located in space contested by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="R59:EL" /> During the war, [[Mina Bonteri's husband/Legends|Mina Bonteri's husband]] went to Aargonar to set up a base, but died there during a [[Battle on Aargonar|battle]] with the Republic's clone troopers.<ref name="HoBS" /> About a year after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Aargonar was the site of a significant [[Battle of Aargonar (Clone Wars)|battle]] of the Clone Wars involving [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]].<ref name="R59:EL" /> Despite Skywalker's heroic actions, the Republic forces were overwhelmed and forced to evacuate the planet.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Aargonar's third moon acted as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Aargonar 3 rebel base|base]], but the Rebels were [[Battle of Aargonar (Galactic Civil War)|routed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="RES" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Aargonar was [[Battle of the Aargonar system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]]. As of [[137 ABY]], Aargonar was located in the territories controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' misspells this planet as "Aagonar".
